name: team01-the-async-actors
description: Playwright BDD automation framework for Suite8

scripts.clean:reports: rimraf allure-results allure-report playwright-report test-results tests/generated
scripts.test:all: npm run clean:reports && npm run bddgen && playwright test
scripts.test:login: npm run clean:reports && npm run bddgen && playwright test --grep "@TestScenario_login_01"
scripts.test:local:headed: cross-env TEST_ENV=local HEADLESS=false npm run test:login
scripts.test:debug: cross-env TEST_ENV=local npm run clean:reports && npm run bddgen && playwright test --debug

author: Team01 The Async Actors
